start.title: Getting started
start.stepSession: Create a session: address, authentication, and any jump hosts on the way.
start.stepHostKey: Confirm the host key on the first connection. A key that has changed stops the connection instead of asking twice.
start.stepTerminal: Open a terminal, or the file workbench beside it.
start.pending: These steps need the vault, which is the next milestone: there is nowhere safe to keep credentials yet, so sessions cannot be created from here.
